OKTEDataGeneratorPiece.name: OKTEDataGeneratorPiece
OKTEDataGeneratorPiece.description: Generate synthetic OKTE electricity market data (spot price, imbalance, scheduled and actual generation) in batch or realtime-like mode.

time_step_minutes.description: Time step between generated records in minutes.
time_step_minutes.title: Time Step Minutes

interval_ms.description: Realtime interval hint in milliseconds (only used in realtime_stream mode).
interval_ms.title: Interval Ms

start_at.description: Optional start datetime in ISO format. Defaults to current UTC time.
start_at.title: Start At

seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible output.
seed.title: Seed

timezone_offset_hours.description: Timezone offset in hours applied to Date/Time columns (CET = 1.0).
timezone_offset_hours.title: Timezone Offset Hours

target_column.description: Suggested target column for downstream preprocessing/training pieces.
target_column.title: Target column

SyntheticDataGeneratorPiece.name: SyntheticDataGeneratorPiece
SyntheticDataGeneratorPiece.description: Generate synthetic tabular datasets for multiple smart-grid data domains in batch or realtime-like mode.

dataset_type.description: One of: `solargis`, `microstep`, `shmu`, `okte`, `battery`, `machine` (aliases like `SoalrGIS Dataset` and `shmi` are also accepted).
dataset_type.title: Dataset Type

time_step_minutes.description: Time step between generated records in minutes.
time_step_minutes.title: Time Step Minutes

start_at.description: Optional start datetime in ISO format.
start_at.title: Start At

seed.description: Optional random seed for reproducible synthetic data.
seed.title: Seed

timezone_offset_hours.description: Timezone offset used by SolarGIS-like records.
timezone_offset_hours.title: Timezone Offset Hours

target_column.description: Suggested target column for the generated dataset (pass downstream via fromUpstream).
target_column.title: Target column

PVOUTPredictionModelTrainPiece.name: PVOUTPredictionModelTrainPiece
PVOUTPredictionModelTrainPiece.description: Template piece for training a PVOUT prediction model.

feature_columns.description: Feature columns used for training (consumed from preprocessor/decider).
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

ModelSpec.description:
Typed bundle that matches `InferencePiece.ModelSpec`.

Exposed as a single typed output so a downstream `InferencePiece.models[i]`
entry can bind to one trainer in a single click instead of toggling each
field separately. Inference reads the same field names so Domino's UI
matches them by name.
ModelSpec.title: ModelSpec

model_path.description: Path to trained model checkpoint (consumable upstream → inference.model_path).
model_path.title: Model Path

feature_columns.description: Feature columns used at training time (consumable upstream → inference.feature_columns).
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

target_column.description: Target column used at training time.
target_column.title: Target Column

data_path.description: Echoed input data path (consumable upstream → error-correction trainer / inference).
data_path.title: Data Path

model_spec.description: Single-element list mirroring `InferencePiece.pvout_model` so the entire bundle binds in one click. `model_path`, `data_path`, `feature_columns`, `target_column`, `mode`, and `base_forecast_column` are pre-populated with sensible PVOUT-baseline defaults.
model_spec.title: Model Spec

artifacts.description: Optional outputs (e.g., trained model URI, training metrics).
artifacts.title: Artifacts

ExplainablePredictionPiece.name: ExplainablePredictionPiece
ExplainablePredictionPiece.description: Template piece for generating prediction explanations (e.g., feature attributions) alongside inference results.

ForecastBinding.description:
Structural mirror of `InferencePiece.OutputModel.forecasts[*]`.

Lets a single upstream edge `ExplainablePrediction.forecasts ← Inference.forecasts`
auto-populate per-model explanations without manual per-entry wiring.
ForecastBinding.title: ForecastBinding

forecasts.description: Per-model forecast entries — wire in one click from `InferencePiece.OutputModel.forecasts`. Each entry's `model_path`, `data_path`, `feature_columns`, `target_column` drive the explanation run for that model.
forecasts.title: Forecasts

artifacts.description: `input_payload` on no-op. On run: aggregated `per_model = {model_id: {...}}` plus first-entry top-level keys for back-compat.
artifacts.title: Artifacts

ModelDeciderPiece.name: ModelDeciderPiece
ModelDeciderPiece.description: Template piece for selecting a model/version based on context, data availability, or policies.

problem_type.description: Forecasting problem this DAG addresses. One of: `pvout_prediction`, `pvout_error_correction`, `price_prediction`. Currently informational only — the decider does not branch on this value yet.
problem_type.title: Problem Type

horizon.description: Prediction horizon in steps. Examples: `1` for single-step forecasting, `96` for 24 hours at 15-minute resolution.
horizon.title: Horizon

available_models.description: Candidate model identifiers. Click `+` to add one or more of: `xgb_regressor_model`, `linear_regression_model`, `interval_xgb_regressor_model`, `eda_rule_baseline`, `tabpfn_regressor_model`. The decider picks `xgb_regressor_model` when available.
available_models.title: Available Models

feature_columns.description: Optional explicit feature list. Usually left empty — downstream trainer/inference should wire its own `Feature Columns` directly from the preprocessor.
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

target_column.description: Target column name to forecast. Default `PVOUT` for solargis-style datasets.
target_column.title: Target Column

data_path.description: Optional passthrough of the preprocessed data path. When wired upstream from `DataPreprocessingPiece.Data Path`, this is echoed to downstream pieces so the linear chain only needs one upstream edge per node.
data_path.title: Data Path

feature_columns.description: Echoed feature columns (consumable upstream → trainer / inference).
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

data_path.description: Echoed preprocessed data path (consumable upstream → normalization / trainer / inference).
data_path.title: Data Path

decision_path.description: Path to the on-disk decision.json artifact.
decision_path.title: Decision Path

artifacts.description: Optional outputs (e.g., selected model id/version, decision rationale).
artifacts.title: Artifacts

TestGpuSupprtPiece.name: TestGpuSupprtPiece
TestGpuSupprtPiece.description: Piece that starts PyTorch in a GPU container and reports CUDA devices and a small GPU matmul probe.

cuda_available.description: Whether PyTorch can access CUDA at runtime.
cuda_available.title: Cuda Available

cuda_version.description: CUDA version PyTorch was built against.
cuda_version.title: Cuda Version

device_count.description: Number of CUDA devices visible to PyTorch.
device_count.title: Device Count

devices.description: CUDA device metadata reported by PyTorch.
devices.title: Devices

current_device.description: Current CUDA device index when a GPU is available.
current_device.title: Current Device

gpu_available.description: True when PyTorch sees at least one CUDA device.
gpu_available.title: Gpu Available

gpu_operation_result.description: Result of a small PyTorch matmul on GPU when available.
gpu_operation_result.title: Gpu Operation Result

gpu_operation_error.description: Error from the small PyTorch GPU operation when it could not run.
gpu_operation_error.title: Gpu Operation Error

ForecastAggregatorPiece.name: ForecastAggregatorPiece
ForecastAggregatorPiece.description: Aggregates per-model forecast CSVs (from InferencePiece) into one comparison CSV, joining on datetime + horizon and optionally adding the actual target column from a preprocessed dataset.

ForecastEntry.description:
A single per-model forecast to include in the aggregated CSV.

Mirrors `InferencePiece.OutputModel.forecasts[*]` so the two pieces wire
directly without any reshape on the orchestration side.

model_id.description: Identifier used to suffix the aggregated `pred_<model_id>` column.
model_id.title: Model Id

forecast_csv_path.description: Path to this model's forecast CSV (produced by InferencePiece).
forecast_csv_path.title: Forecast Csv Path

ForecastEntry.title: ForecastEntry

forecasts.description: Per-model forecast entries. Typically wired from `InferencePiece.OutputModel.forecasts`.
forecasts.title: Forecasts

actual_csv_path.description: Optional CSV containing the ground-truth target column (e.g. preprocessed dataset). When supplied, an `actual_<target>` column is added. The target column name is taken from the first forecast entry's `target_column`.
actual_csv_path.title: Actual Csv Path

forecast_column.description: Column in each forecast CSV that holds the model's prediction.
forecast_column.title: Forecast Column

include_diff.description: If true and an actual column is present, also emit `diff_<model_id>` columns.
include_diff.title: Include Diff

output_csv_name.description: Filename of the aggregated CSV under `results_path`.
output_csv_name.title: Output Csv Name

aggregated_csv_path.description: Path to the produced aggregated CSV (None on no-op).
aggregated_csv_path.title: Aggregated Csv Path

model_ids.description: Identifiers of models present as `pred_<id>` columns.
model_ids.title: Model Ids

n_rows.description: Number of rows in the aggregated CSV.
n_rows.title: N Rows

InferencePiece.name: InferencePiece
InferencePiece.description: Runs inference on prepared features: pvout_correction or price_ahead (base + model correction).

ModelSpec.description:
One trained-model entry consumed by InferencePiece.

The canonical workflow exposes two named slots (`pvout_model`, `price_model`)
on `InferencePiece.InputModel`. Each binds in one click to the matching
trainer's `model_spec` output. Top-level fields like `datetime_column` are
inherited into each entry at runtime.

model_id.description: Stable identifier for this model (used in forecast filenames and per-model artifacts). Falls back to the slot name (`pvout` / `price`) when omitted.
model_id.title: Model Id

data_path.description: Path to input CSV (defaults to parent payload's data_path when missing).
data_path.title: Data Path

preprocessing_metadata_path.description: Optional explicit metadata JSON next to the model checkpoint.
preprocessing_metadata_path.title: Preprocessing Metadata Path

stages.description: Optional nested staged inference for this entry (advanced).
stages.title: Stages

ModelSpec.title: ModelSpec

pvout_model.description: PVOUT-side model bundle (add a single entry to this card). Per-field values can be Upstream-bound from `PVOUTErrorCorrectionModelTrainPiece` (`model_path`, `feature_columns`, `target_column`, …). Typically `mode=pvout_correction` with `base_forecast_column=PVOUT`.
pvout_model.title: Pvout Model

price_model.description: Price-side model bundle (add a single entry to this card). Per-field values can be Upstream-bound from `ElectricityPricePredictionModelTrainPiece`. Typically `mode=price_level` or `price_ahead`.
price_model.title: Price Model

datetime_column.description: Datetime column name shared by both models (inherited into each slot when not set per-model).
datetime_column.title: Datetime Column

horizon_column.description: Horizon/id column name shared by both models (inherited into each slot when not set per-model).
horizon_column.title: Horizon Column

max_horizon.description: Optional maximum horizon shared by both models.
max_horizon.title: Max Horizon

model_id.description: Identifier of the model that produced this forecast.
model_id.title: Model Id

forecast_csv_path.description: Path to forecast CSV for this model (consumable by EvaluateMLModel / aggregator).
forecast_csv_path.title: Forecast Csv Path

data_path.description: Path to the INPUT dataset used to generate this forecast — i.e. the data passed to `model.predict()`. Required by ExplainablePrediction so it can re-feed the same rows to SHAP / LIME from a single edge.
data_path.title: Data Path

forecasts.description: Per-model forecast outputs. Length matches the number of input models.
forecasts.title: Forecasts

forecast_csv_path.description: Back-compat scalar: path to the first entry in `forecasts`. Downstream nodes still wired to single-model inference keep working.
forecast_csv_path.title: Forecast Csv Path

model_path.description: Back-compat: echoed checkpoint path of the first model.
model_path.title: Model Path

data_path.description: Echoed input data path shared across models (when uniform).
data_path.title: Data Path

feature_columns.description: Back-compat: feature columns of the first model.
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

target_column.description: Back-compat: target column of the first model.
target_column.title: Target Column

artifacts.description: `input_payload` on no-op; `per_model` mapping `{model_id: {forecast, per_horizon, metadata, debug?}}` plus aggregate `stage_summaries` when stages are used.
artifacts.title: Artifacts

target_column.description: Target column used at training time.

DataPreprocessingPiece.name: DataPreprocessingPiece
DataPreprocessingPiece.description: Template piece for cleaning, validating, and preprocessing input data prior to feature engineering or training.

data_path.description: Single-source input path (back-compat alias for `data_path_solargis`). Use the more specific `data_path_solargis` / `data_path_okte` fields below to merge Solargis + OKTE datasets into one preprocessed CSV.
data_path.title: Data Path

data_path_solargis.description: Path to Solargis-style CSV (weather / PVOUT). Wire upstream from `SyntheticDataGeneratorPiece.File Path`.
data_path_solargis.title: Data Path Solargis

data_path_okte.description: Path to OKTE-style CSV (electricity market). Wire upstream from `OKTEDataGeneratorPiece.File Path`. When both Solargis and OKTE paths are provided, the piece inner-joins them on `datetime` and emits one merged dataset with all features.
data_path_okte.title: Data Path Okte

target_column.description: Target column for prediction mode. Defaults to `PVOUT` (SolarGIS). Set to e.g. `spot_price_eur_mwh` for OKTE data.
target_column.title: Target Column

data_path.description: Path to preprocessed CSV (consumable upstream → normalization / trainer / inference).
data_path.title: Data Path

feature_columns.description: Resolved feature columns (consumable upstream → trainer / inference).
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

artifacts.description: Optional outputs (e.g., cleaned dataset URI, dropped rows stats).
artifacts.title: Artifacts

DataNormalizationPiece.name: DataNormalizationPiece
DataNormalizationPiece.description: Template piece for normalizing raw smart-grid data into a consistent scale and schema.

normalization_type.description: One of: `none`, `min_max`, `z_score`, `logaritmic`, `exponential`. Use `none` (passthrough) for tree-based models like XGBoost. Usually wired upstream from `ModelDeciderPiece.Normalization Type`.

features.description: Optional list of column names to normalize. Empty = apply to all numeric columns. Click `+` and add column names like `GHI`, `TEMP`, `WS`.

data_path.description: Path to input CSV. Wire upstream from `DataPreprocessingPiece.Data Path` (the preprocessor's `preprocessed.csv`).
data_path.title: Data Path

dataframe.description: Optional inline dataframe payload (JSON object). Leave empty when `Data Path` is provided.
dataframe.title: Dataframe

feature_columns.description: Optional passthrough of feature columns from upstream. Echoed to downstream pieces so trainer/inference need only one upstream edge.
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

target_column.description: Optional passthrough of the target column from upstream. Echoed downstream.
target_column.title: Target Column

model_type.description: Optional passthrough of the selected model type from upstream. Echoed downstream.
model_type.title: Model Type

data_path.description: Path to normalized CSV (consumable upstream → trainer / inference).
data_path.title: Data Path

feature_columns.description: Echoed feature columns from upstream (consumable upstream → trainer / inference).
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

target_column.description: Echoed target column from upstream (consumable upstream → trainer.target_column).
target_column.title: Target Column

model_type.description: Echoed selected model type from upstream (consumable upstream → trainer.model_type).
model_type.title: Model Type

artifacts.description: Optional outputs (e.g., normalized dataset URI, fitted scaler params).
artifacts.title: Artifacts

PVOUTErrorCorrectionModelTrainPiece.description: Template piece for training a PVOUT error-correction model.

When set, the baseline is used to generate the predicted-PVOUT column required by the XGB error-correction models, removing the need for an explicit inference step between the trainer and this piece.

feature_columns.description: Feature columns used for training (also for baseline inference).
feature_columns.title: Feature Columns

Exposed as a single typed output so a downstream `InferencePiece.models[i]`
entry can bind to one trainer in a single click instead of toggling each
field separately. Defaults pick the residual-correction wiring.

model_path.description: Path to trained correction model checkpoint (consumable upstream → inference.model_path).

feature_columns.description: Feature columns used at training time (consumable upstream → inference.feature_columns).

target_column.description: Target column used at training time.

data_path.description: Echoed input data path (consumable upstream → inference).

baseline_model_path.description: Echoed baseline model path (the upstream `model_path` consumed by this piece). Forwarded so staged inference can reach both checkpoints from a single edge.

EvaluateMLModelPiece.name: EvaluateMLModelPiece
EvaluateMLModelPiece.description: Template piece for evaluating a trained ML model and producing metrics/artifacts.

ForecastBinding.description:
Structural mirror of `InferencePiece.OutputModel.forecasts[*]`.

Lets a single upstream edge `EvaluateMLModel.forecasts ← Inference.forecasts`
auto-populate per-model evaluations without manual per-entry wiring.
ForecastBinding.title: ForecastBinding

forecasts.description: Per-model forecast entries — wire in one click from `InferencePiece.OutputModel.forecasts`. Drives evaluation: one metrics.json per forecast, with `pred_df_path` / `target_column` / `forecast_column` auto-derived from each entry (mode-aware: `correction` for `pvout_correction`, `final_forecast` otherwise).
forecasts.title: Forecasts

metrics_path.description: Path to this entry's metrics JSON.
metrics_path.title: Metrics Path

metrics.description: Per-entry metrics. Length matches the number of evaluations.
metrics.title: Metrics

artifacts.description: `input_payload` on no-op. On run: aggregated `per_model = {model_id: metrics}` plus first-entry `metrics`, `metrics_path`, `evaluation_option` at top level for back-compat.
artifacts.title: Artifacts
